title: Reading Drill — Testing a train stop announcement — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a train stop announcement — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The station announcer in Millcross received an old report about customers confusing stations with similar names. The report compared the proportion of stops identified correctly, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the short listening trials rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered five weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include background conversations. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed an added neighbourhood reference as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
